Migrate camellia scene, AI, and square pages (#45)

Summary:
- add grouped scene, ai, and square navigation with matching permission
  nodes in the shared camellia shell
- add shared migration state plus ten first-round route modules for
  portrait, tattoo, wrong-book, ai, and square tag pages
- keep list filters, tables, and edit dialogs aligned to the existing
  shared scaffold patterns

Rationale:
- DAM-28 requires clear landing spots for the scoped legacy universal
  pages in the new backend
- centralizing seeded migration state keeps the first-round routes
  consistent and makes cross-page edits predictable during review
- wiring the routes through the same shell validates menu access and
  role-based visibility before any backend integration follow-up

Tests:
- pnpm --dir bougainvillea --filter @bougainvillea/camellia typecheck
- pnpm --dir bougainvillea --filter @bougainvillea/camellia build
- PORT=3210 pnpm --dir bougainvillea --filter @bougainvillea/camellia
  start
- curl 200 checks for /, /scene/portrait, /scene/tattoo/element,
  /scene/wrong/dict, /ai/template, /square/tag, /system/role
